JOB OBJECTIVE 
Results-driven Operations and Asset Servicing professional with 13+ years of experience across 
Wells Fargo, JP Morgan, and State Street. Expertise in Asset Servicing, Corporate Actions, Custody 
Operations, Client Escalation Management, Transition Management, Risk & Control, Stakeholder 
Management, and Process Improvement. Proven track record of leading global teams, driving 
operational excellence, strengthening controls, and delivering high-quality service within SLA and 
regulatory requirements. Experienced in managing transitions, process optimization, and cross -
functional collaboration across global banking environments. 
 PROFILE SUMMARY 
• Dynamic professional with over 13 years of experience in Asset Servicing, 
Corporate Actions, and Custody Operations leadership within the financial services 
industry, with expertise in process optimization, operational excellence, custodian 
bank client management, and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration across 
global banking environments. 
• Proven expertise in driving operational efficiency, consistently delivering top-tier results 
through strategic planning, owning management tools/methods such as work queues, 
checklists, depth charts, process improvements, and cross-functional collaboration with 
internal and external stakeholders. 
• Skilled in resolving complex client escalations, overseeing client service operations, and 
implementing risk mitigation strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and meet business 
goals. 
• Demonstrated success in resource management, including talent development, allocation 
of financial resources, and ensuring adherence to SLAs, while fostering long-term relationships 
with clients and business partners. 
• Adept at leading change initiatives, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and 
maintaining high service standards to support business growth and customer retention. 
• Expert in Investment Management, conducting in-depth financial analysis, managing asset 
servicing, and delivering evidence-based recommendations for investment opportunities and 
client acquisitions. 
• Strong Track Record in Cross-Functional Collaboration, worked closely with internal teams, 
stakeholders, and clients to ensure compliance, resolve escalations, and achieve business 
objectives. 
• Migration &Transitions: Virtual and onsite Transition and process setup in India.
